name: Hollow Warden

source.note: Entered from reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within, which reworked the 2025 Unearthed Arcana version; the published numbers for Wrath of the Wild (AC bonus, aura save) are not confirmed. Compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Rangers who take their strength from old and hungry horrors of the deep wilds and grow monstrous in turn.

feature.name: Hollow Warden Spells
feature.summary: Wrathful Smite always prepared; more at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17.
feature.text: Always prepared from the Ranger level shown: 3 Wrathful Smite; 5 Alter Self; 9 Phantom Steed; 13 Dominate Beast; 17 Steel Wind Strike.

feature.name: Wrath of the Wild
feature.summary: Bonus Action, a Favored Enemy use: transform for 1 minute: +AC, a 10-foot aura that frightens foes, and an Opportunity Attack when a foe hurts you or an ally beside you.
feature.text: Cost: a Bonus Action and one Favored Enemy use. You change for 1 minute (or until you end it, free), sprouting rotten bark, bristles or bloody antlers. While changed: your AC rises by your Wisdom modifier (+1 at least); an enemy that starts its turn within 10 ft of you must pass a Wis save against your spell save DC or be Frightened until its next turn starts; and when a creature within your reach damages you or an ally standing within 5 ft of you, you may use your Reaction for an Opportunity Attack on it.

feature.name: Hungering Might
feature.summary: +Wisdom modifier to Constitution saves; while transformed and Bloodied, a hit heals 1d10 + Wisdom modifier once per turn.
feature.text: Constitution saves gain your Wisdom modifier (+1 at least). While changed by Wrath of the Wild and Bloodied, a hit with an attack roll heals you 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier, once per turn.

feature.name: Rot and Violence
feature.summary: While transformed, creatures your aura frightens can't regain Hit Points or take Reactions, and your weapon hits can add Sap or Slow to their own mastery.
feature.text: While changed by Wrath of the Wild: creatures Frightened by your aura can neither regain Hit Points nor take Reactions; and a weapon hit can trigger Sap or Slow on top of the weapon's own mastery property.

feature.name: Ancient Endurance
feature.summary: Immune to Exhaustion; +Wisdom modifier damage against Frightened creatures; once per Long Rest (or a level 4+ slot) dropping to 0 while transformed leaves you at 30 Hit Points.
feature.text: Timeless: Exhaustion can't touch you. Dread Hunter: while changed, add your Wisdom modifier to damage you deal to Frightened creatures. Persistent Hunt: when you drop to 0 Hit Points while changed and survive, go to 30 Hit Points instead; this resets on a Long Rest, or at once if you burn a spell slot of level 4 or higher (free).
